entries.message: Feature - Add saving-state feedback for episode watch actions and changelog release-process filtering
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Add saving-state feedback for episode watch actions and changelog release-process filtering
Feature: Episode tiles pulse with a "Syncing..." overlay while marking watched/unwatched is in flight, including collapsed season accordion headers during whole-show or whole-season bulk actions
Feature: Marking unwatched from the show control bar now batches requests in groups of 100, fixing shows with more than 100 watched episodes silently failing with no explanation

Feature: The poster three-dot overflow menu (Mark Unwatched / Edit watch date / Fix match) now appears on TV show library cards and stays legible in light mode instead of rendering as dark-on-dark dots
Fix: Batch watch-state dispatch by media identity
Fix: Marking an entire show as watched now excludes Season 0 specials by default
Fix: The watched-date dialog shows an Include specials (Season 0) checkbox, unchecked by default, to opt them back in
Fix: Batch related watch-state updates by shared media identity to make large syncs safer and avoid duplicate provider work.
